# ProgressRing

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:progress-ring` · Kerf UI · component · Feedback

A circular progress indicator: an SVG track and arc, determinate (filling clockwise from the top) or an indeterminate spinning arc, in small, medium, and large sizes to sit inline in text, a row, or a toolbar, as a named progressbar.

## When to use

Show compact progress (a claim's time remaining, a per-row upload) where a bar does not fit.

- Progress belongs beside an item in a row, a toolbar, or a line of text: pass value and max, a label, and valueText for speech.
- A compact indicator of work of unknown length: omit value for the spinning arc.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it where a full-width readout fits and the amount matters; use ProgressBar.
- Do not use wa-progress-ring.

**Alternatives:**

- [ProgressBar](./progress-bar.md) (nearest) — Use a ProgressBar where a full-width bar with a label row fits.
- [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md) (nearest) — Use a LoadingSpinner for a brief busy glyph inside a control.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/progress-ring` — exports `ProgressRing`, `ProgressRingProps`, `ProgressRingSize`, `ProgressRingRootAttributes`, `ProgressTone`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/progress-ring` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/progress-ring.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/progress-ring`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiprogress-ring) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- determinate arc
- indeterminate spinning arc
- small (16px), medium (24px), or large (40px)
- brand, success, warning, or danger tone

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the value, max, and valueText; the label; the tone and size.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Its box is exactly its diameter, so it aligns with icons of the same size.

## Accessibility

- It is role progressbar named by label, with aria-valuenow as a percentage (or valueText); the SVG is decorative.
- The spin holds still under prefers-reduced-motion or the static-effects switch; forced colors draw a GrayText track and a Highlight arc.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-progress-ring`, `kui-progress-ring__track`, `kui-progress-ring__arc`.

Never put `kui-progress-ring`, `kui-progress-ring__track`, `kui-progress-ring__arc` on an element you write; render `ProgressRing` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
